lines.text: This is a real iPhone, driven from Windows. No Mac. No jailbreak.
It reads the actual screen, finds real buttons, and types like a person. You watch every move, live.
Under it all: the real U I element tree. Exact buttons, exact labels.
Nervous? Same. That is why the red stop button freezes everything, and ambiguous sends abort before a word gets typed.
A free Apple I D is enough. One command fixes the signing Apple makes hard.
Your PC can text your mom now. Clone it free and drive your phone.
